subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] kernfs: don't lose IN_DELETE_SELF when decoding a file handle

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the kernfs file system where IN_DELETE_SELF notifications are lost when decoding a file handle. The issue occurs because __kernfs_remove() clears i_nlink on a node's inode, making it invisible to subsequent passes that hash its inode. The patch takes a read lock on kernfs_rwsem to prevent this loss of notification and ensures that the inode is hashed before the ilookup() pass runs. This fix was tested with a 300ms delay between lookup and inode hashing, resulting in st_nlink being correctly set to 0 when removing a file in a cgroup directory.
